_about: Everything a player can carry in their Pack (scripts/camp/camp_pack.gd), the Pack itself and dropped bundles. Each player has pack_slots slots; a slot holds a stack of one item, up to stack_max. Nothing is ever lost: a full Pack just can't take more, and what can't fit stays where it is. items: each item's kind (fish, meal, fruit, plant or material), which requests ask for (data/guests.json); box: true when the camp box takes it (materials). fuel lists the items the fire burns to grill, one per meal, from the Pack first and then the camp box. A dropped stack lies as a bundle (model) at the dropper's feet and never goes away; a stack dropped within merge_m of a bundle of the same item joins it. reach_m is how near a player picks a bundle up or reaches the camp box (box_model in data/clearing.json). Names: data/text.json items.<item>.
